settings.title: Folio3 Strengthened Opportune's IT Operations, Security & Infrastructure

settings.editor: Folio3 works alongside Opportune's internal IT team to provide additional technical capacity across IT support, Microsoft 365, security, infrastructure, compliance, and ongoing technology initiatives.

settings.text: Talk to a Managed IT Expert

settings.editor: Reliable managed IT support, helpdesk, technical support, and IT operations to keep your business running smoothly.

settings.title: Scaling IT Operations Across a Complex Environment

settings.editor: Opportune required additional technical capability across Microsoft 365, endpoints, infrastructure, security platforms, and compliance activities while maintaining consistent day-to-day IT operations.

The requirement extended across multiple areas of the technology environment. Opportune needed additional operational capacity, stronger security visibility, infrastructure optimization, and technical support for ongoing compliance and governance activities.
Additional L1/L2/L3 technical capacity was required to manage growing operational requirements, technical issues, and escalations.
The environment required stronger security monitoring, endpoint visibility, email protection, and ongoing validation of security controls.
Opportunities existed to optimize server resources, connectivity, lifecycle management, and overall infrastructure efficiency.
Opportune required technical support for SOC 1/SOC 2 IT controls, audit readiness, documentation, access reviews, and technical verification.

settings.title: A Managed IT Model Built Around Opportune's Internal IT Team

settings.editor: Folio3 operates as an extension of Opportune's internal IT organization, providing dedicated technical support and proactive improvements across Microsoft 365, endpoints, security, infrastructure, and daily IT operations.
Folio3 supports Exchange Online administration, mailbox management, user onboarding and offboarding, access management, and Microsoft 365 productivity requirements.
The team supports Microsoft Intune administration, device management, endpoint security, and the transition toward Omnissa UEM.
Folio3 supports Mimecast email security, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne environments, security logging validation, and ongoing security posture improvements.
Folio3 provides Windows Server support, hosted environment management, backup activities, server lifecycle management, and network connectivity support.
The team supports security control reviews, access reviews, evidence preparation, security logging validation, and technical verification for SOC 1/SOC 2 activities.

settings.title: A More Secure, Efficient & Resilient IT Function

settings.editor: Through its ongoing partnership with Opportune, Folio3 helped strengthen IT operations while improving security, compliance readiness, infrastructure efficiency, and technology governance.
